skills.description: This skill should be used when a researcher needs to automate finding, downloading, and archiving full-text academic PDFs from free/legal sources. It parses paper clues (a DOI, a "title | author | year" string, or a .txt/.csv/.xlsx list), probes channels in a compliance-first order (OpenAlex, Unpaywall, Semantic Scholar, DOAJ, Europe PMC, Crossref publisher links, arXiv preprints), downloads and validates each PDF, deduplicates by normalized DOI, and emits a manifest.csv with source trust levels. Sci-Hub-style mirror sources are OFF by default and only engage as a last resort when no legal OA version is found AND the user explicitly enables allow_mirror. Triggers include "下载这篇论文全文", "批量下文献", "找开源全文", "把 DOI 列表转 PDF", "academic fulltext", "OA 下载", "论文归档".
